name: Open Terminal
description: Open Terminal provides remote command execution, interactive terminals, and file management through an authenticated API. Connect it to Open WebUI to use a terminal and browse files alongside your chats.

notes.text: In Open WebUI, add the container URL and OPEN_TERMINAL_API_KEY from /opt/open-terminal_data/.env under Admin Settings → Integrations → Open Terminal.
The API key grants root command and file access inside this LXC. Share it only with trusted users; use separate instances when users need isolation.
